acceptance_policy: Available uploaded/external measurements and source-backed response relations are accepted as identification references now; transfer recalibration may revise them later. Acceptance for identity does not constitute device/reference calibration.
reference_ppm_policy: Available source-backed PPM curves are accepted now for candidate fitting, ranking, and provisional operator/reference concentration estimates. They may be recalibrated later. They do not constitute M4, compliance measurement, or safety-grade quantitative interpretation.

conditioning.mq7_mq9_heater_cycle_note: The 48 h initial preheat is complete, but it does not replace the separate manufacturer high/low heater cycle. MQ7/MQ9 source curves remain excluded until cyclic-heater hardware/protocol validity is available; their raw signals remain usable for empirical HR069 fingerprint acquisition.

priority: peer-reviewed exact sensor/analyte curve inside published domain
registered GasEngine relation accepted by SensorOperatingEnvelope
MQDataScience/datasheet-derived ResearchCurveRegistry relation inside declared domain
derivation_policy.duplicate_policy: Use the highest-provenance relation for a physical sensor/analyte channel. Do not average regression coefficients.
derivation_policy.heater_policy: MQ7/MQ9 channels are excluded from source-curve classification/PPM fitting unless the current heater-cycle validity is explicitly true. Completed 48 h initial preheat is recorded separately.
derivation_policy.quantitative_policy: Accepted templates and PPM curves are current identification/reference tools only. M4 remains required for occupational/safety-grade quantitative interpretation.

runtime_identity_gate.minimum_score_margin_or_distance_margin: score margin >= 5 points OR runner distance - top distance >= 0.20
runtime_identity_gate.ppm_policy: fingerprint promotion itself sets no safety-grade ppm; provisional PPM hypotheses come from accepted source-backed response models; M4 remains required for reportable occupational ppm
